title: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Hemodynamic Management of Sepsis in the ICU: a MIMIC-IV Study with Dual Off-Policy Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2608.16482v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The dosing of intravenous fluids and vasopressors in sepsis is a sequential decision made under uncertainty and guided largely by clinical judgment, which makes it a natural target for reinforcement learning from historical care. Because a learned policy cannot be trialed on patients, its value must be estimated off-policy, and such estimates can be fragile and optimistic. This work advances the reliable evaluation of sepsis treatment policies by combining off-policy estimation, reliability diagnostics, and clinician-agreement analyses in a transparent validation framework. translated_title: 脓毒症ICU血流动力学管理的离线强化学习：基于MIMIC-IV的双离线策略评估研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：在脓毒症中，静脉输液和血管加压药的给药是一个在不确定性下做出的序贯决策，主要依赖临床判断，这使得它成为从历史护理中进行强化学习的自然目标。由于学习到的策略无法在患者身上进行试验，其价值必须通过离线策略进行评估，而此类估计可能脆弱且过于乐观。本研究通过在一个透明的验证框架中结合离线策略估计、可靠性诊断和临床医生一致性分析，推进了脓毒症治疗策略的可靠评估。我们基于MIMIC-IV重症监护数据库中的36,872例脓毒症ICU住院记录，对液体和血管加压药给药进行了建模，将其作为离散马尔可夫决策过程，包含1,000个状态和25个动作，由五乘五的液体和血管加压药水平网格定义，并通过策略迭代求解。临床医生的行为策略使用随机森林进行估计，该模型...
tldr: 本研究提出一个结合离线策略估计、可靠性诊断和临床医生一致性分析的透明验证框架，用于在MIMIC-IV数据上可靠评估脓毒症ICU血流动力学管理策略。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a transparent validation framework combining off-policy estimation, reliability diagnostics, and clinician-agreement analyses to reliably evaluate sepsis ICU hemodynamic management policies on MIMIC-IV data.
